categories.name: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC)
categories.content: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC) refers to social media platforms and protocols that operate without a central authority over user data, content, or infrastructure.

categories.name: STX.CITY Ecosystem
categories.content: STX.CITY Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via STX.CITY.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Product
categories.content: Yield tokenization product refers to converting the expected future yield or returns from an asset into tradable tokens on a blockchain, allowing for the trading, management, and optimization of yield independently from the underlying asset.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: SocialFi
categories.content: SocialFi combines social media and DeFi. It aims to bring a more decentralized and user-centric approach to social media platforms, allowing users to monetize their interactions and content directly.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: Ether.fi Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around Ether.fi.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Tessera Tokenized Pre-IPO Assets
categories.content: Tessera is a private equity marketplace that tokenizes institutional-grade shares in private companies, providing fractional exposure through regulated proxy instruments.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Ohm Fork
categories.content: An Ohm fork is a change to the underlying code of the Olympus DAO's OHM protocol that results in a split into a separate versions of the protocol.

categories.name: Yield Farming
categories.content: Yield farming involves putting cryptocurrency into a DeFi protocol to collect interest on trading fees. Liquidity providers can profit by providing liquidity in DeFi protocols like Uniswap, utilizing assets that would otherwise sit idle on an exchange or hot wallet.

categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.
